description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-13 under road-to-skill-scripts-that-run-where-they-land, which rewrote this skill's grounded stack-guidance invocation to the bundled `node <skills-root>/…/ground.mjs` form and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are the surfaces its own When-to-use names — views, components, partials, layouts, forms, and view logic — on a project that is Blade without Livewire or Flux, which is the condition that makes this skill rather than its two siblings the answer. Near-misses are exactly the three boundaries the skill draws for itself: reactivity (livewire), a Flux primitive (flux), and the design brief it executes but never writes (fe-design, via directives/ui). Counterexamples guard two words rather than a neighbour — a saw blade and a database view.

queries.q: create a Blade component for the invoice line-item row
the same header markup is copy-pasted across six views — pull it into a layout and a partial
this view does a foreach with the discount calculation inside it — move the view logic where it belongs
build the settings page as plain Blade — the project has no Livewire
add a @props-driven alert component we can reuse across the templates
bau eine Blade-Komponente für die Rechnungsposition-Zeile
this table should refresh when a filter changes, without a page reload
queries.note: reactivity → livewire, which composes Blade internally

queries.q: use the Flux modal primitive for the confirm dialog
the spacing and type scale on this page feel off — decide the layout and the states
queries.note: the design brief this skill executes but never writes → fe-design / directives/ui

queries.q: our saw-blade supplier changed their SKU format — update the product import mapping
add a database view for the reporting query so BI can read it
